This appeal coming on for admission this day, the court passe  ORDER Heard on the admission.
Admit.
With the consent of parties, final arguments heard.

The appellant/claimant has filed this Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 for enhancement of the compensation amount being aggrieved with the award dated 15/04/2021 passed by Third Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Sagar (M.P.) in MACC No.450/2017, by which the learned Claims Tribunal awarded a total sum of Rs.1,10,820/- (One Lakh Ten Thousands Eight Hundred Twenty) with 7%
interest to the appellant/claimant by way of compensation for the injuries, which he has sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

sentences.text: According to claimant i.e. appellant herein, the compensation awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal is on lower side and hence, need to be enhanced.

3. Since, this appeal is for the enhancement in the compensation amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal, hence the question that arises for consideration is whether any case for enhancement in compensation awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal on facts and evidence adduced, is made out and if so to what extent?
4. It is not necessary to narrate the entire facts in detail, such as how the accident occurred, who was negligent in driving the offending vehicle, who is liable for paying compensation etc.
It is for the reason that firstly all these findings are recorded in favour of appellant/claimant by the Tribunal.

Secondly, the findings though recorded in the favour of claimant are not under challenge at the instance of any of the respondents such as owner/driver or insurance company either by way of filing an appeal or cross-objection.
In this view of the matter, there is no justification to burden this order by detailing facts on all these issues.

5. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that in a motor accident which took place on 17/03/2017 the appellant sustained grievous injuries and learned Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.1,10,820/- (One Lakh Ten Thousands Eight Hundred Twenty) breakup of which is as under :
Rs.50,000/- Towards pain, suffering and mental shock Rs.32,400/- Towards loss of income during treatment Rs.18,420/- Towards expenses incurred in treatment Rs.10,000/- Towards transportation and special diet 6.
Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that meagre amount has been awarded under various heads and no amount has been awarded in the head of grievous injuries sustained by appellant/claimant.

It is prayed that the appeal be allowed and amount of compensation be enhanced substantially.
7.
I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
8. From perusal of record it appears that appellant sustained two fractures in the body of appellant in the alleged incident and Tribunal has not awarded any amount in the head of grievous injury.
Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, in my considered opinion a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Fifty Thousand) will be sufficient to award under the head of grievous injury.
On other heads, amount awarded by the learned Tribunal appears to be just and proper.

9. In view of above discussion, appellant/claimant shall be entitled for the following amount of compensation :-
Rs.50,000/- Towards pain, suffering and mental shock Rs.32,400/- Towards loss of income during treatment Rs.18,417/- Towards expenses incurred in treatment Rs.10,000/- Towards expenses on attendant and special diet Rs.50,000/-

Towards grievous injury Tej Singh vs Mukesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61848267/
2 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Rs.1,60,817/- Total ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Rounded up as Rs.160820/- (One Lakhs Sixty Thousand Eight Hundred Twenty)
10.
Thus, appeal filed by the appellant/claimant is allowed.
The appellant/claimant will be entitled for a total sum of Rs.1,60,820/- (One Lakh Sixty Thousand Eight Hundred Twenty) instead of Rs.1,10,820/- (One Lakh Ten Thousands Eight Hundred Twenty).
Thus, there shall be enhancement to the tune of Rs.50,000/- ( Fifty Thousand), which shall fetch interest @ 6% per annum from the date of filing of claim petition till the date of actual payment.
Enhanced amount shall be paid with interest within sixty days from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
Other terms and condition of the award shall remain intact.
11. With the aforesaid, appeal stands disposed of.
12. Records of the claims Tribunal be sent back alongwith the copy of this order for information and necessary compliance.
No order as to costs.

(AMAR NATH (KESHARWANI)) JUDGE skt Tej Singh vs Mukesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61848267/
